use std::cell::Cell;
use std::panic::{catch_unwind,AssertUnwindSafe};
__HELPERS__
struct Value<'a>(&'a Cell<usize>);
impl Drop for Value<'_>{fn drop(&mut self){self.0.set(self.0.get()+1);}}
struct Env<'a>(&'a Cell<usize>);
impl Drop for Env<'_>{fn drop(&mut self){self.0.set(self.0.get()+1);}}
struct Values<'a>{items:std::vec::IntoIter<Value<'a>>,env:Env<'a>,next_panic:bool,last_panic:bool,calls:usize}
impl<'a> Iterator for Values<'a>{
 type Item=Value<'a>;
 fn next(&mut self)->Option<Self::Item>{self.calls+=1;if self.next_panic&&self.calls==2{panic!("next once");}self.items.next()}
 fn last(self)->Option<Self::Item>{if self.last_panic{panic!("last once");}self.items.last()}
}
fn make<'a>(drops:&'a Cell<usize>,envs:&'a Cell<usize>,next_panic:bool,last_panic:bool)->Values<'a>{Values{items:(0..3).map(|_|Value(drops)).collect::<Vec<_>>().into_iter(),env:Env(envs),next_panic,last_panic,calls:0}}
fn main(){
 let drops=Cell::new(0);let envs=Cell::new(0);
 assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||__boxed_last_sized(Box::new(make(&drops,&envs,false,true))))).is_err());
 assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(3,1));
 let iter:Box<dyn Iterator<Item=Value<'_>>+'_>=Box::new(make(&drops,&envs,true,false));
 assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(||__boxed_last_fallback(iter))).is_err());
 assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(6,2));
 let result=__boxed_last_sized(Box::new(make(&drops,&envs,false,false))).unwrap();assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(8,3));drop(result);
 assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(9,3));
 let iter:Box<dyn Iterator<Item=Value<'_>>+'_>=Box::new(make(&drops,&envs,false,false));
 let result=__boxed_last_fallback(iter).unwrap();assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(11,4));drop(result);
 assert_eq!((drops.get(),envs.get()),(12,4));println!("boxed helper ownership complete");
}
